note: The 65.9% ordinary progress that put 2804 on the revision lists is a one-off investment-securities gain announced in April (operating progress only 24.8%), and the identical setup last October revised ordinary up 8.3% and still closed -0.15% then -1.78%; the 優待 and buyback legs are small option-like positives, so the net is close to zero on a 1.6%-median mover.

Item 0 is the one line this print adds — the first Aug-2027 DPU guide — and the primary-document arithmetic (cruise DPU 2,465 against a 2,700 payout, reserve down to ~253 yen/unit, BOJ at 1.0% after the February assumptions) makes a sub-2,700 guide the likelier surprise, with 543x margin longs as the sellers and three prior new-guide prints at -0.45 to -1.04%.

The guidance line, which is what moves this name (four cuts at -5.9 to -10.5%), was pre-released on 10-16, so item 0 goes to roughly zero net of H2-ramp scepticism; what is left unpriced is the buyback option — frame completed early on 9/18, Oasis at 8.7%, PBR 0.77, net raised to 7.0bn, against no H1-print precedent — plus the November price hike set after the guide.

The H1 beat against the 1,044億 plan is near-mechanical on realised Q2 FX and the demand series (JMTBA +60.4%, Yaskawa record orders) all point one way, but the FX gap is public and IFIS already sits 4.9% above the guide, and the Q1 print is the explicit veto — orders beat by 400-500億, guide raised, stock -14.31% — so the sum stays well under a 4.5%-median name's scale.

Item 0 is the day's strongest case: Q1 book-to-bill 1.18 and a 174億 backlog against an H1 guide needing only 221億 of Q2 sales, an independent peer series (Yageo September +4.5% m/m) still rising, KOA has raised its FY plan at four consecutive prints for next-session moves of +17.3/+22.2/-4.5/+11.6 with a mechanical 30%-payout dividend attached, and the 28% drawdown since 10/06 is sector beta with no KOA disclosure; capped for an unsourced street bar and the adverse FX in item 2.

Q1 ordinary profit at 58.2% of the H1 plan against 47.0/46.5% in the prior two years leaves Q2 needing only 1,438m where it did 1,739m and 1,879m, and the 50%-payout policy makes a dividend raise mechanical on a revision — the combination paid +8% in July — but the street already sits 12.5% above the company plan on a single unverifiable estimate, and the October 2025 analogue of a held plan on strong progress was sold ~3.5%.

An honest zero: H1 was pre-released to the million yen on 10/16, the 65-yen interim was pre-announced on 9/18 and went ex on 9/29, the company publishes no full-year forecast, and no buyback appears anywhere in the disclosure record — the five prior confirming 短信 moved +0.4 to -2.0% with no consistent sign, so only the minor vendor data leak carries any residual.

The release carries the first 2027/8 forecast, and the Kobe Steel exit from ON Building (4.1% of NLA, ~1.24bn of NOI, the replacement tenant phasing in only from 2027-04 to 2028-04) is 100-170 yen a unit of drag against 1,795 that nobody has guided and the four prior October new-guide prints all printed negative (-0.59 to -2.88%); a second ON lease riding with the package is the real upside tail.
